meta.title: Ba Na Hills Worth It? 🇻🇳 Golden Bridge Reality & Da Nang Travel Guide
meta.description:
Welcome to Da Nang, Vietnam 🇻🇳 with Yonder Passport! ✈️🌏

In this vlog, we explore some of the best experiences Da Nang and Ba Na Hills have to offer — from the iconic Golden Bridge and scenic cable car ride to our stay at Mercure Bana Hills French Village.

And that's not all! We also explore the local market and experience the spectacular Dragon Bridge Fire Show in Da Nang. 🔥🐉

Come along with us as we explore, eat, stay and experience Vietnam through our eyes!

📍 Places featured:
✨ Golden Bridge, Ba Na Hills
🚠 Ba Na Hills Cable Car
🏨 Mercure Bana Hills French Village
🛍️ Ba Na Hills Market
🔥 Da Nang Dragon Bridge Fire Show
🇻🇳 Da Nang, Vietnam
